4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: An MVP of your ROLLER mod — built from your design document with AI help (SchoolAI Mon–Tue, Copilot from Wed), split across multiple JavaScript files — with a player-controlled character, a basic setting, at least 2 states, and 1 working mechanic that creates a challenge, playable and pushed to your repo by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can play a classmate's game or finish my own so that my MVP is ready to turn in tonight.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Quick model: giving useful playtest feedback (3 min)
You do: play finished games / finish your MVP with Copilot (17 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your MVP link (3 min)
4th Period.connections: All week you built your MVP piece by piece: character, controls, mechanic, second state. Today there's no lecture — if yours is playable, you play other people's and tell them one thing to fix. If it isn't, you have the whole period with Copilot to get it there. Next week you take that feedback and keep building on top of your MVP.
